subject: Onsite Demo — OrbitAI Visit Day Plan, Entry Passes & AV Needs
messages:
From: Jenny Park <jenny@orbitai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Visiting Redwood for demo week — heads up & preferred dates

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for agreeing to host a short onsite demo next week. Tom (CTO) and I will be in the Bay Area and would love to stop by Redwood for a 90-minute walkthrough and Q&A. High-level preferences:

- Preferred day: Tuesday 1/12 or Wednesday 1/13 (flexible)
- We’ll arrive ~10:30am and plan to end by 12pm
- AV needs: HDMI laptop hookup, room for a 12-person roundtable, projector optional
- Two visitors: me (Jenny Park) and Tom Walker

We need to sign your visitor NDA and arrange building access — can you point me to the right contact? Also, any parking or delivery instructions for a rental car would help.

Attaching a short company overview.

Thanks,
Jenny Park
Head of Partnerships | OrbitAI
[jenny@orbitai.com]

Attachments: orbitai_onepager.pdf (PDF)
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Park <jenny@orbitai.com>, Tom Walker <tom.walker@orbitai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Visiting Redwood for demo week — heads up & preferred dates

Hi Jenny / Tom — great to hear you'll be nearby. Tuesday 1/12 works for us. Proposed plan below:

- 10:30am — Welcome & check-in (lobby)
- 10:45am — 90-minute demo in Conference B (6th floor, AV ready)
- 12:15pm — Quick follow-up / next steps by conference call

Karthik — can you confirm Conference B availability and AV setup? Also confirming we can provide visitor badges and a security escort to/from the lobby.

Jenny — I'll send a DocuSign NDA link; please sign before arrival. Also attaching directions/parking note. If anything needs to change, we can pivot to 1/13.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_hq_site_map.pdf (PDF)

To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Visiting Redwood for demo week — heads up & preferred dates

Olga — Conference B is available on 1/12 from 10:00–13:00. AV team (BayAV) is on our vendor roster; they're booked for the morning already but can re-slot for 10:15 if we confirm today.

Requests for the visit:
- I need the signed NDA before we share any internal runbook/demo notes. Can someone confirm DocuSign when completed?
- Do the visitors have laptop adapters (USB-C -> HDMI)? We'll have one spare but if they have M1s they should bring a dongle.
- Catering: small coffee + pastries? (opt-in via diet)

Marissa — please place a security escort at 10:25 and reserve two visitor badges at the lobby kiosk. I can coordinate AV with BayAV (cc'd).

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer

Attachments: none

Subject: Re: Visiting Redwood for demo week — heads up & preferred dates

Hi Olga — thanks. I signed the NDA (DocuSign receipt attached) and Tom will bring his USB-C adapter just in case. We do have one dietary restriction (gluten-free).

Attached: signed_nda_orbitai.pdf (DocuSign)

Two quick asks:
1) Can Karthik share the room link or floorplan so Tom knows where to go?
2) Any preferred entrance for parking — we may be in a car with a small trunk (equipment).

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Jenny

All set for 1/12:
- Visitor badges printed: Jenny Park, Tom Walker (will be at the lobby kiosk; security escort at 10:25am)
- Parking: Please use Dock 3 delivery entrance; pull up and security will direct to temporary unload.
- AV: BayAV confirmed HDMI/USB-C adapters and a projector; setup at 10:00, quick test at 10:20.
- Catering: gluten-free pastries + coffee (set for 10:15).

I also uploaded a visitor pass PDF to the shared drive and attached the site map.

Attachments: visitor_pass_instructions.pdf

See you Tuesday — I'll meet you at the lobby.

Marissa Cole
